name: pyrocade
description: 3D carousel front-end for emulators with built-in emulator downloader/updater

scripts.dist:macos:arm64: tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg && mkdir -p dist && cp -f src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: tauri build --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles app && mkdir -p dist && cp -f src-tauri/target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/bundle/app/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dist:android:arm64: npm run tauri:android:configure && RUSTC="$(rustup which rustc)" tauri android build --target aarch64 --apk --split-per-abi --ci && mkdir -p dist && cp -f src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/arm64/release/*.apk dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
